fields.title: Amazon search result record
fields.description: Two record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. PRODUCT is one product from a search results page. CAPTCHA_ESCALATION marks a search term that was blocked, CAPTCHA'd, or supplied as a URL Amazon will not serve as a SERP, so a short run is never mistaken for a small market. Amazon's SERP carries no brand element, and Prime/delivery depend on the exit country, so those fields are nullable by nature — as is every other field.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term or URL keyword this row came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-search-page for a product, S0-diagnostic for a failure row.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Keyword this result was found under.

targetUrl.title: Target URL
targetUrl.description: The search URL that was scraped.

page.title: Page
page.description: Results page this product appeared on.

position.title: Position
position.description: Rank across all pages for this search term, 1-based.

title.title: Title
title.description: Product title, with Amazon's 'Sponsored Ad - ' prefix stripped.

brandGuess.title: Brand (derived)
brandGuess.description: DERIVED from the leading words of the title, NOT scraped. Amazon's search results carry no brand element at all, so this is a heuristic and will be wrong for titles that open with a model or size. Do not treat it as authoritative.

price.title: Price
price.description: Current price. Null when the result showed no price, e.g. 'See options' multi-variant tiles.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency symbol as displayed, pinned to the marketplace rather than the proxy country.

discountPercent.title: Discount percent
discountPercent.description: Computed from list price versus price, only when the list price is genuinely higher.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Exact number of ratings, taken from the aria-label. The visible text is abbreviated ('10.5K'); that abbreviation is only used as a fallback and is expanded to a number.

boughtInPastMonth.title: Bought in past month
boughtInPastMonth.description: Units Amazon reports bought in the past month, expanded from '6K+' to 6000. A demand signal Amazon publishes on most results.

isAmazonsChoice.title: Is Amazon's Choice
isAmazonsChoice.description: Carries the Amazon's Choice or Overall Pick badge.

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: Raw badge labels found on the tile, e.g. Best Seller, Overall Pick.

isPrime.title: Is Prime
isPrime.description: Prime eligibility. This depends on the delivery country Amazon infers from the exit IP — from a non-Prime country no result shows Prime at all, so use a residential proxy in the marketplace's country before trusting a false value.

deliveryInfo.title: Delivery info
deliveryInfo.description: Delivery line as shown, e.g. 'FREE delivery Mon, Sep 15'. Also geo-dependent.

shipsTo.title: Ships to
shipsTo.description: Destination country Amazon inferred from the request IP. If this is not the marketplace's own country, treat Prime and delivery as unreliable.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: BLOCKED, CAPTCHA or INVALID_TARGET on a diagnostic row, otherwise null.
